theme.description: A premium, cinematic media-processing platform. Distinctive, brutalist precision meets high-end studio atmosphere. Completely avoids generic AI/SaaS tropes (no purple gradients, no Inter, no rounded soft cards). High density data display combined with dramatic, editorial spatial layouts.

headings.style: Bold Geometric Sans. Use tight tracking (tracking-tight) for large sizes. Represents cinematic scale and authority.

body.style: Grotesque Mono. Used for timestamps, tabular data, exact transcriptions, and precise controls. Communicates technical rigor and density.

colors.intent: Deep obsidian void with stark white geometry and a single high-energy 'Electric Signal Orange' for active recording/processing states. Avoid generic blues or purples.

hero_background.description: Granular black and white abstract texture. Use as a low-opacity fixed background overlay across the entire app (opacity-10 mix-blend-overlay) to break digital flatness.

studio_context.description: Condenser microphone in dark studio lighting. Use in feature sections highlighting audio enhancement or high-fidelity processing.

dashboard_context.description: Professional video editor working with dual monitors in dimly lit studio. Good for testimonials or 'built for professionals' sections.

layout_spacing.system: Generous spacing philosophy (p-12, gap-8) for marketing sections. Tight 'Control Room' grid (gap-4) for dashboard/viewer.
layout_spacing.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px solid borders (border-border) to define spatial relationships instead of soft drop shadows.
layout_spacing.radius: 0px (Sharp). Utilitarian, brutalist tech vibe. Card components should be rectangular blocks.

motion.interactions: Crisp transitions. On hover, elements shouldn't softly lift, they should snap into high contrast (e.g. border changes to --primary, background shifts to slightly lighter grey).
motion.loaders: Use ASCII art or monospaced blinking text cursors (e.g., 'PROCESSING_...') instead of generic spinning circles.

hero.layout: Asymmetrical. Huge left-aligned headline. Right side is an abstract void or large URL input form.
hero.input: Paste-and-go YouTube URL input must be brutalist: a giant rectangular input block (h-16), stark text, 1px sharp border, high contrast 'Extract' CTA button in Electric Signal Orange.
hero.visuals: No generic illustrations. Use the granular noise texture overlay (opacity-10) over a deep black background.

transcript_viewer.layout: Split-pane cinematic viewer. Uses grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12.
transcript_viewer.video_pane: col-span-1 md:col-span-5. Sticky on scroll. Border-r border-border.
transcript_viewer.transcript_pane: col-span-1 md:col-span-7. Scrollable. Dense, editorial typography.
transcript_viewer.timestamps: JetBrains Mono. Pinned to the left side of the transcript block. Dimmed grey until active.
transcript_viewer.active_state: The currently spoken sentence lights up stark white with an Electric Orange left-border indicator. Smooth auto-scroll.

summarizer_panel.layout: Bento Grid Mode B ('Control Room'). Tight gap-4.
summarizer_panel.cards: Cardless or 1px sharp borders. High density. 'Key Points' presented in terminal-like list with monospace numbering [01], [02], etc.
summarizer_panel.ai_indicator: Avoid generic magic wand icons. Use a technical label like 'SYS.ANALYSIS' with a pulsing orange dot.

translator_panel.styling: Two-column technical layout (Original vs Translated). Sync scrolling if side-by-side.
translator_panel.dropdowns: Shadcn Select customized to be sharp rectangles, dark grey backgrounds, monospace font for language codes (e.g., [EN-US], [ES-ES]).

pricing_cards.style: The 'Grid Borders' tech look. All cards sit in a single border-collapse container.
pricing_cards.highlights: Pro/Enterprise tier has a 'Tracing Beam' effect (1px glowing orange line around the border) or simply a solid 2px primary border, completely flat.
pricing_cards.cta: Flat background colors. Inverse text. No gradients.

dashboard.layout: Control Room layout. Side navigation with Phosphor Icons. Main area uses full width.
dashboard.table: Batch processing queue is a dense Shadcn Table. Status badges are small sharp rectangles (e.g., [PROCESSING], [DONE]). Monospaced exact file sizes (450.2 MB).

navigation.style: Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/70 border-b border-white/10) so it overlays the grain texture perfectly. Pinned z-50.
navigation.brand: Text logo using 'Outfit' font, bold tracking tight. E.g., Y/T_TRANSCRIPT.

footer.style: Massive scale contrast shift. py-24 or py-32 border-t border-white/10.
footer.cta: A giant text link filling the width (e.g., text-[8vw]), 'START EXTRACTING ->', changing to Electric Orange on hover.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure pure contrast on text overlay. Text must hit APCA guidelines or standard WCAG AA (4.5:1).
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: CRITICAL: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, language dropdowns, transcript lines, copy buttons) MUST have a descriptive data-testid attribute (e.g., 'url-input-field', 'extract-submit-btn', 'transcript-line-12', 'tab-summarizer').

icons.style: Duotone or Regular weight, providing a highly precise, technical geometry.
